source_only_inventory.name: HSD_GetClassInfo
source_only_inventory.finding: Returns the class_info field; no null guard.

source_only_inventory.name: HSD_PushClassInfo
source_only_inventory.finding: Identity function returning its input; no stack.

source_only_inventory.name: hsdChangeClass_inline
source_only_inventory.finding: Typed implementation; same-size ancestor identity gates rebinding. Decrements the normalized old ancestor count, not necessarily the original concrete descriptor; increments requested destination. Old class pointer is not asserted by the discarded logical expression.

source_only_inventory.name: class_set_flags
source_only_inventory.finding: Computes (flags & ~reset) | set; overlapping set bits win.

source_only_inventory.name: ForgetClassLibraryChild
source_only_inventory.finding: Scans only immediate children, recursively forgets matching subtrees and unlinks those roots; no search through nonmatching descendants.

source_only_inventory.name: DumpClassStat
source_only_inventory.finding: Prints two indented lines from class name, signed sizes and live/peak counts.

source_only_inventory.name: hsdDelete
source_only_inventory.finding: Null guard; release first, then rereads class_info to select destroy, so release may change subsequent dispatch.
